messages:
kelly: noticed something bad in prod canary — bulk-assign bumped labels on rows from another org. customer complained. :grimacing:

dave: which deploy rolled the bulk-assign change?

deploy-bot: deploy: frontend/bulk-assign 2026-03-20T14:22Z canary -> prod-a

kelly: repro steps: open insights for org 90, select items across pages using multi-select, click assign label 'review'. API responded success but count included rows with ids for org 91.

mina: payload from the client shows mixed ids. UI stores selection under localStorage key `bulk_select_key` with no org prefix. quick-switch keeps selection alive.

frank: server rule: we must validate every id against X-Org-ID header and reject if any mismatch. plan to return 400 with code ERR_CROSS_ORG_WRITE and include a human-friendly message.

mina: on the frontend we'll prefix selection key with org id and clear ambiguous keys during migration. also show toast: "Selection cleared after org switch" with a link to docs.

kelly: owners: frank (server), mina (frontend). I'll handle CS outreach and repro notes.

ops-bot: query-start: SELECT count(*) FROM label_events WHERE org_id != caller_org AND ts > now() - interval '24 hours'; id=Q-11300
ops-bot: query-done: rows=4 id=Q-11300

dave: 4 events in 24h. rollback canary while we patch.

deploy-bot: action: rollback frontend/bulk-assign canary -> previous at 2026-03-20T14:18Z initiated by dave
deploy-bot: rollback-complete: succeeded

frank: opening server PR now. Will add validation, a failing unit test for mixed-org payloads, emit metric cross_org_write_attempts_total, and log sanitized examples for debugging.

mina: frontend PR will add org prefix + one-time migration to clear existing ambiguous keys. we'll send telemetry event selection_cleared_org_switch with previous_count.

kelly: adding incident stub: cause=global selection persisted across org switch + canary timing; impact=label writes to wrong org; mitigation=rollback + server validation + frontend migration; owners=[frank, mina]; eta=EOD tomorrow.

dave: also add CI e2e that simulates quick-switch mid-selection and asserts server rejects cross-org writes.

kelly: agreed. I'll attach repro script and customer ticket to the PRs. closing loop when server patch live and CS contacted. :thumbsup:
